explanation.S: Section 80C lets you reduce your taxable income by up to Rs 1,50,000 per year -- but only if you choose the Old Tax Regime. It covers common investments and expenses: PPF, ELSS mutual funds, life insurance premiums, principal repayment on a home loan, and children's tuition fees, among others. The New Regime does not allow this deduction at all, which is a big part of why the two regimes can give very different results for the same income.
